extras: All image processing uses the browser/Electron Canvas API locally inside Obsidian. No network requests are made, and no image data ever leaves your device.
problem: Large image files can increase vault size and slow down performance in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: image compression and batch conversion work cleanly with media managed by Media Companion.

summary: Automatically compresses and converts images to WebP format when pasted, dropped, uploaded, or during batch conversion.
